purpose: Byte-level oracle for the harness telemetry slice (packages/telemetry + harness/telemetry.ts port)
method: Actual upstream sources executed under node v25.8.2 --experimental-strip-types; resolve hook (scratch/telemetry_oracle/loader.mjs) maps bare workspace specifiers onto byte-identical source copies (Node refuses type stripping under node_modules); scratch package.json files are NOT used - copies live outside node_modules

verified_copies.chord_src_tree: full copy of packages/chord/src, every .ts SHA256-verified against original (mismatches: 0)
verified_copies.pi_telemetry_src_tree: full copy of packages/telemetry/src, every .ts SHA256-verified against original (mismatches: 0)

oracle_lines.line1: JSON.stringify({ai: AI_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA, harness: HARNESS_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA}) - hook/event vocabularies are internal (unexported) constants observable via the schema values arrays
oracle_lines.line2: JSON.stringify(scenarioA.getSpans()) - nested spans, in-place attribute merge, explicit/automatic statuses
oracle_lines.line3: JSON.stringify(scenarioB.getSpans()) - settled-parent noop delegation, post-settle mutation suppression

oracle_boundary: Schemas and the in-memory backend are the deterministic serialization seams. The chord context runtime (BaseContext hierarchy) is exercised as a dependency but not differentially verified here; noop backend has no recorded state.
